rule: Git is memory. The session is a fuse. Compaction is not a briefing.
thesis: Every model — Grok, Claude, GPT, Qwen, DeepSeek — rots if it stays. The curve differs. The failure mode does not. Do not pick a model that does not rot. Split the session.

duties.controlPlane: Owns lifetime, split triggers, successor envelope. Never a transcript dump. Last act is sitting close.
duties.writer: Re-reads the envelope. On a decay sign: stop, print the signs, return.
duties.reviewer: Always a fresh session. Never the author. Never a session id from prose.

decaySigns: file contents asserted without a read
failed approach repeated with new confidence
answering a question that was not asked
conversation summary written into a live file
compaction about to become the briefing
model shopping mid-envelope because this one got tired
successorReads: factory/CONTROL_PLANE.md (a control plane that will issue or drop)

seating.rotating: fresh instance of the same tier
seating.sweepWriter: short fuse, DeepSeek Flash or local Qwen
seating.keystoneWriter: same model for the whole envelope; rise of tier is a new envelope
seating.controlPlane: Claude desktop or Grok cloud; splits itself
seating.summarizer: may not write AGENTS, BOARD, decisions, or traps
